verdicts.reason: A reworks the layout properly for the banner: the sneaker is large on the left and the copy panel sits on the right. But the 'DROP 07' eyebrow has dropped below the subhead and is set big, so it competes with the headline and breaks the reading order. The headline, subhead and eyebrow are also jammed together, the panel runs off the right edge, and the logo is undersized. B is just the square shrunk into the middle of the wide canvas, not rearranged. The subhead, eyebrow and CTA shrink to small text, the sneaker is reduced, and wide dead confetti strips fill both sides, so it reads as a scaled-down square and not a banner.
